description: Fan-out search by identifier, results grouped by source: ticker (13 collections), company_cik (11), cusip (4), bioguide_id (congressional_trades, annual_financial_disclosures; in both, a record's party is the party the member held on the date of the record (a trade's transaction date, a disclosure's filing date); for a date outside the member's terms in office, the party of their nearest term (the last one before that date, or the first one after it).), recipient_uei (federal_contracts), company_name (5 name-keyed, plus the ticker and CIK it resolves to). Congressional-trade and annual financial disclosure results come from STOCK Act and Form 278 filings. The same filings are published free as news at https://keyvex.com/disclosures under 5 U.S.C. § 13107(c). A failed or unreached source sets partial: true. Collections: keyvex.com/docs/tools/unified_search

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on each source's primary date.

sources.description: Only these sources (names as in sources_queried).
